Physical stimulus and fixture: Photograph A1 revision, PMIC markings and L6/R25/R27/R28 stuffing, both add-on PCB revisions, B1 label and J7 keys. Continuity-test wiring with power removed.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Approve net-to-net drawing, signed W1/W2/W3 polarity records, received parts and closed-shell assembly BOM. Run V2 netlists only on matching configuration.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Use battery emulator and current-limited supply for initial power-up. Record CC/CV, precharge, termination, recharge, charger cold-start and off-state USB insertion on each permitted source. Read PMIC registers before and after firmware config.
Capture or acceptance evidence: No charge outside cell-supplier voltage/current/temperature envelope. Record tolerance and instrument uncertainty. Within 500 mA maximum for the currently selected B1. A nominal 300 mA firmware setting requires measurement and off-state protection.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Use a pack emulator, resistor box and representative instrumented enclosure to test TS behavior, open/short, power-off charging and pack/core vs board temperature. Never cause battery faults on a live pouch for this functional test.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Measure TS ADC/source configuration. Demonstrate cell-specific inhibit and hysteresis at supplier temperature limits, before boot and while asleep. Resolve the two-wire B1 temperature coverage.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Log attach, USB2 default host before configuration, configured host, charge-only adapter, C-to-C orientation, suspend/resume, idle and combined play-charge loads. Read input limit; monitor D+/D− and current.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Current stays within available source/configuration budget in every state. No cycling or excessive connector rise. Match USB descriptor and actual permitted draw.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Exercise low/high charge states and cable hot-plug/unplug during Wi-Fi transmit, LCD at maximum, loudest sustained audio, high motor duty, flash write and OTA. Probe J7, VSYS and MCU 3V3 simultaneously with short ground connections.
Capture or acceptance evidence: MCU rail stays within operating range; record duration and margin relative to actual brownout threshold. No unexplained reset or corrupt journal. Derive effective impedance and correlate charge-deficit cases.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Measure powered-off aggregate pull-up equivalent with system isolated. Measure powered 30–70% rise, VOL, ringing and setup/hold on SDA and SCL at both ends of W1. Compare base and haptic assemblies; exercise touch/IMU/encoder together.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Fast-mode rise ≤300 ns, VOL and sink current meet capabilities of every populated peripheral. Log NACK/error and recovery under extended stress, cable movement and motor operation.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Bench stock and remote key at full/low battery and with USB/charging, signed test from poweroff. Scope K3 raw, PMIC PWRON, CHIP_PU, LCD_RST. Test release, pocket pressure, contamination proxy with an isolated calibrated series resistor.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Document timing for 1 s power-on and 4 s off settings, debouncing, no duplicate press, no unintended boot/reset. Confirm key pinout and margin on actual revision.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Measure differential J9 voltage with actual 6 ohm speaker and a power-rated differential dummy load. Sweep every music/cue/click combination and simultaneous wireless/rumble activity in free and closed cases.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Record RMS/crest, per-band thermal power, clipping, PA temperature, audible artifacts and acoustic level. Freeze gain/duty so sustained speaker dissipation meets supplier limits with margin.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Measure differential output, input current, motor DCR/spin-up, duty/brake and temperature for all effect IDs and repeated clicks. Sweep reel speed and direction with the motor/battery installed.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Pass selected motor electrical and thermal limits; no encoder dropout or false tooth under motor start. Capture all settings including off.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Measure T1 gate duty and backlight supply current across intended settings. Run 9-point touch grid on battery/USB after closing enclosure and while motor/reel active.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Record panel voltage/current/margin and acceptable touch-grid accuracy, zero phantom closures, readable text and suitable brightness in sealed unit.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Test both orientations, qualified short and long cables, cold attach, bootloader enumeration, full reflash, USB eye if lock requires, resets and production ESD by qualified lab.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Stable links, captures vs USB envelope, verified flash CRC/identity and normal boot. USB passive simulation does not close ESD, EMI, RF or certification.

Circuit or function: RF, RTC, IMU and accessory effects
Physical stimulus and fixture: Test multiple assembled units and grips at minimum battery; compare antenna throughput by grip pose, calibrate IMU, exercise Wi-Fi multiplayer and sleep/clock holdover.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Record RSSI/range, packet loss, time drift/sync, physical motion thresholds, charge consumption by state and serial-numbered evidence.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Instrument battery current by workload and storage mode, capacity at cutoff and air/cell/chip/enclosure temperatures. Log between lots. Establish assembly short, continuity and functional factory checks.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Reconcile actual mission energy and thermal limits before product claims. Approve repeatable EOL limits and every hardware/firmware configuration.

Physical stimulus and fixture: Use current-limited emulator, known-good firmware and host fixture. Interrupt update/power during each flash stage; disconnect/reconnect external peripherals; exercise safe fallback, credentials reset and factory reflash.
Capture or acceptance evidence: Verified recovery, saved-data integrity, bootloader/release identity, signed-update/rollback behavior and harness fault handling with revision-controlled logs.
